title: Follow-up for #1316: @supports serialization
items: Don't print redundant inner parentheses for a single-prefix declaration (`((-moz-appearance:none))`): add them in SupportsCondition::to_css only when more than one prefix is set.
Optional: dedupe exact duplicates inside `and` (rare, 0 bytes on the corpus).
note: Branch pushed; PR held until one of #1434/#1435/#1436 merges (3-open cap).
